companyNotes: Huawei Technologies (Thailand) works with customer infrastructure, service delivery, cloud systems, networks, and operational support across enterprise and telecom environments.
jobDescription: IT Engineer (IT-Infra) role in Huai Khwang, Bangkok. Responsibilities include deployment, implementation, and maintenance of hardware and application software at customer sites; customer communication; technical solutions; incident support; troubleshooting; root cause analysis; continuous improvement; project coordination; service delivery milestones; SLA requirements; reporting; risk assessments; coaching junior engineers; Linux and Windows administration; server, storage, virtualization, and cloud infrastructure; IP networking; KVM, OpenStack, Hyper-V, cloud storage, backup, migration, and disaster recovery.
letter: I am interested in the IT Engineer (IT-Infra) role at Huawei Technologies (Thailand) Co., Ltd. because it connects closely with the kind of work I value: supporting reliable systems, solving practical infrastructure problems, and working with customers to keep important services running well. Huawei's work across customer infrastructure, cloud systems, networks, and service delivery is especially interesting to me because it combines technical depth with real operational responsibility.

In my current work as a Software Engineer, I work across backend systems, cloud deployment, and DevOps support. I build and maintain services, support production releases, troubleshoot issues, and improve delivery workflows using AWS, Docker, Linux, and CI/CD practices. This has helped me understand how software, infrastructure, deployment, and operations connect in real projects, especially when reliability and clear communication matter.

The responsibilities of this role are attractive to me because they involve more than only technical implementation. I would enjoy working with customers to understand requirements, coordinate with internal teams, investigate incidents, prepare clear updates, and recommend improvements that make systems more stable. My academic background in Electrical and Electronic Engineering, together with my master's study in telecommunication and networking systems, also gives me a strong foundation for infrastructure, networks, and system behavior. I am motivated to continue deepening my experience in IT infrastructure, server and cloud environments, virtualization, backup, migration, and disaster recovery work.

I would welcome the opportunity to contribute to Huawei Thailand's IT infrastructure team and grow in a customer-facing engineering environment with high service expectations. Thank you for considering my application. I would be glad to discuss how my software engineering, cloud, DevOps, and networking background can contribute to this role.
